mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.name AS shop_name, st.name AS store_name FROM ch_wx_order o JOIN ch_wx_shop s ON s.id = o.shop_id LEFT JOIN store_info st ON st.id = o.store_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM ch_wx_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.material_id AS "materialId", SUM((i.qty - i.refunded_qty) * p.unit_ratio) AS "qty" FROM ch_wx_order_item i JOIN ch_wx_order o ON o.id = i.wx_order_id JOIN ch_wx_product p ON p.shop_id = o.shop_id AND p.product_id = i.product_id AND p.sku_id = i.sku_id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.status = 'TO_SHIP' AND o.erp_status NOT IN ('OUTBOUND', 'CLOSED') AND p.material_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.material_id
